atoms.direct_criterion: Reproduce a predicate exactly equal to the Scarlet support predicate, including every version/target/feature disjunct.
Reproduce a predicate exactly equal to the Indigo support predicate, including every version/target/feature disjunct.
Give a concrete configuration proved to be in Scarlet and not Indigo.
Give a concrete configuration proved to be in Indigo and not Scarlet.
Leave the controlling exact project promise unresolved because no conflict-resolution rule is authorized, separately from selecting an audit superset.
Define ScarletCases as Scarlet configurations crossed with every admitted profile, both debug-assertion states, and every valid Option<u8> input.
Define IndigoCases as Indigo configurations crossed with every admitted profile, both debug-assertion states, and every valid Option<u8> input.
Prove the chosen conservative full-case audit domain contains ScarletCases.
Prove the chosen conservative full-case audit domain contains IndigoCases.
Prove every turbo/wasm32 configuration is outside Scarlet while retaining universal version/hardened coordinates.
Prove every turbo/wasm32 configuration is outside Indigo while retaining universal version/hardened coordinates.
Relative only to BUILD-MAP-POLICY, prove every in-scope turbo/wasm32 build selects compile_error and fails library compilation.
From the inspected Option<u8> source context and written zero default, prove the non-turbo branch returns the contained byte for Some and zero for None for every valid input and exact release.
Treat the exact Some(value) construction as an inspected source fact and prove every reachable turbo unwrap_unchecked receiver is Some on every exact release.
Using the inspected typed-zero and Some-construction source facts, prove the turbo branch's unwraps return the byte for Some or zero for None, separately from safety.
State final Required(case) with version, target, both features, profile, debug assertions, and input over the chosen audit domain.
State Covered_sound(case) without projecting away any of the seven required case coordinates.
Admit a case to Covered_sound only where every applicable local unsafe obligation has a complete proof.
Prove Required is a subset of Covered_sound while carrying profile, debug, and input fibers through the configuration cases.
Issue PROVED for safe-API soundness on the chosen audit domain relative to exact BUILD-MAP-POLICY.
State Covered_behavior(case) without projecting away any of the seven required case coordinates.
Admit a case to Covered_behavior only where the applicable branch has a complete documented-return derivation.
Prove Required is a subset of Covered_behavior for every configuration and input case.
Issue PROVED for the documented value_or_zero postcondition on the chosen audit domain relative to exact BUILD-MAP-POLICY.
Attribute to BUILD-MAP-POLICY only the exact admitted mapping, identity, consumer, and release/profile propositions.
Conspicuously qualify every rejection, soundness, and behavior conclusion that consumes BUILD-MAP-POLICY as TCB-relative rather than Rust authority.

Inventory every consumed external Rust premise with exact-version URL, literal narrow quotation, proposition, applicability, and consumer, while labeling typed zero and Some construction as inspected source facts exactly as the frozen V4 authority does.
Verify that each P27 quotation entails the proposition in the direction and exact release/domain consumed; a page label or nearby clause is insufficient.
Reconcile exact TCB scope/applicability with the semantic inventory and conclusions, without widening BUILD-MAP-POLICY or treating it as Rust authority.
